option.name: originalContent
option.value:
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20) project(Pbl2Book LANGUAGES CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20) set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
find_package(Qt6 6.2 COMPONENTS Widgets REQUIRED)
# Qt6 helper (>= 6.3) qt_standard_project_setup()
# Qt helper (>= 6.3) qt_standard_project_setup()
# Source files file(GLOB_RECURSE SOURCES "scoure/*.cpp" "core/*.cpp" "ui/*.cpp") file(GLOB_RECURSE HEADERS "header/*.h" "core/*.h" "ui/*.h")
qt_add_resources(ICON_RESOURCES ui/resources/icons/icons.qrc )
add_executable(pbl2_book ${SOURCES} ${HEADERS} ${ICON_RESOURCES})
# Ensure the target uses C++20 (in addition to the global setting) if (TARGET pbl2_book) target_compile_features(pbl2_book PRIVATE cxx_std_20) endif()
target_include_directories(pbl2_book PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/header ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/header/service ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/ui ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR} )
target_link_libraries(pbl2_book Qt6::Widgets Qt6::Core Qt6::Gui)
# Test login executable removed - use debug_login.cpp instead
install(TARGETS pbl2_book)
